name: Shin Arijigoku
source: Protagonist is a grounds keeper at a mountain resort. He has already trained the wife at his place of employment, and involves her in his scheme to find breeding material. To this end he has her invite her former students as prospects, and confines them to his isolated mountain resort.
translation: 主人公是一家山间度假村的管理员。他已经调教好了工作场所的女主人，并让她参与自己寻找生育素材的计划。为此，他让她邀请以前的学生前来，将她们囚禁在偏僻的山间度假村里。
